articles.title: World Uyghur Congress warns of imminent 2 Uyghur men deportations from Thailand to China
articles.description: The World Uyghur Congress (WUC) has raised alarm over the imminent deportation of two Uyghur men from Thailand to China after they were granted royal pardons and transferred from regular detention to an immigration detention facility on October 21, warning that their return could expose them to torture and enforced disappearance.
